name: Appplication Base Template
subject: Hi ${First_Name} – Application for SWE Role
content:
Hello ${First_Name},

Hope you're doing well!

My name is Parva Shah, and I'm a recent graduate with an MS in Software Engineering from RIT. I'm reaching out to express my strong interest in the Software Engineer role at ${Company}.

I've previously worked as a Researcher and Software Developer, where I successfully built APIs and scalable websites with 500+ daily users. I've also won a hackathon and co-authored a published research paper. I also recently finished an internship where I was shipping production code on day 1, building different ETL Data Pipelines using Kafka, Apache Iceberg, AWS EC2 and S3.

I'm genuinely excited by ${Company}'s work and would love the opportunity to contribute to the team. I've already submitted an application via your careers portal, but I wanted to personally reach out to express my enthusiasm and explore the possibility of joining your engineering team.

I've attached my resume for your reference. Would it be possible to connect or point me to the right person to speak with?

Regards,

Parva Shah

GCCIS Department of Software Engineering

Rochester Institute of Technology

ps7384@rit.edu | LinkedIn | 8484820769
